mapper.select: SELECT item.organization_uuid, item.workspace_uuid, experiment.external_id AS experiment_external_id, item.external_id, item.session_external_id FROM evaluation_experiment_items AS item JOIN evaluation_experiments AS experiment ON experiment.uuid = item.experiment_uuid AND experiment.organization_uuid = item.organization_uuid AND experiment.workspace_uuid = item.workspace_uuid WHERE item.status = 'completed' AND item.session_external_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_experiment_items AS sibling WHERE sibling.experiment_uuid = item.experiment_uuid AND sibling.organization_uuid = item.organization_uuid AND sibling.workspace_uuid = item.workspace_uuid AND sibling.status IN ('pending', 'running') ) AND ( SELECT count(*) FROM evaluation_experiment_scores AS score WHERE score.item_uuid = item.uuid ) < ( SELECT count(*) FROM evaluation_experiment_evaluators AS binding WHERE binding.experiment_uuid = item.experiment_uuid ) ORDER BY item.updated_at ASC, item.uuid ASC LIMIT #{limit}
